neighbours.label: verbs of lowering or opposing something ('reduce', 'decrease', 'against')
fire: Regular exercise can help reduce the risk of heart disease in older adults.
The new filter is designed to decrease the amount of dust in the room.
Planting trees along the street reduces noise from passing traffic.
The senator spoke out against the new tax on small businesses.
Cutting back on sugar will lower your chances of developing diabetes.
The city plans to reduce speed limits near schools next year.
Wearing a helmet greatly decreases the chance of serious head injury.
The rebels continued their campaign against the government in the north.

Planting trees along the street brings shade to people walking by.
The senator spoke out about the new tax on small businesses.
Cutting back on sugar will change your taste for sweet foods.
The city plans to post speed limits near schools next year.
